# Fixture `perf` (WP-27): one 2000-line translation unit (perf_work.cpp, generated by gen_perf_tu.py and checked in) for the
# compile -> applied budget. The edits change perf_value() only:
#   edits/value_2.edit             perf_value 1 -> 2
#   edits/stacked/value_3..6.edit  2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6 (each applies on top of the previous one; the perf scenario
#                                  tests/bench/scenarios/perf.toml reloads after each)
# TICK n=<k> value=1 sum=<checksum>
cml_add_fixture(perf SOURCES main.cpp perf_work.cpp)

add_test(NAME fixture.perf.runs COMMAND fixture_perf --ticks 3)
set_tests_properties(fixture.perf.runs PROPERTIES
    PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "TICK n=2 value=1 sum=[0-9]+"
    TIMEOUT 30)
